company_modal.hint: When the subscription ends, the account is frozen automatically for 30 days, then stopped for good unless renewed. To renew, change the end date to a future date.

template_modal.name: Template name
template_modal.hint: Choose the sections, then set what is allowed inside each one. A section with no actions selected = full permissions on it.

decisions.title: Critical decisions — two people, not one
decisions.intro: Closing an account, erasing its data and changing a subscription: one admin requests and another admin approves. Whoever requested a decision cannot approve it.
decisions.summary_label: Impact summary — read by the approver
decisions.summary_placeholder: What exactly will happen, and to whom

actions.account_erasure: Close an account or erase its data

deletion.title: Account deletion and reopening requests
deletion.note_label: Decision note (sent back to the merchant)
deletion.note_placeholder: Example: we called you to confirm
deletion.confirm_body_reopen: The account "{{company}}" will be reopened and sign-in restored. Do you want to proceed?
deletion.confirm_body_erase: The non-mandatory data of "{{company}}" (phone numbers and contact details) will be erased now; data that must be kept stays until its term ends, and the account cannot be reopened afterwards. Do you want to proceed?
deletion.confirm_body_close: "{{company}}" has activity ({{movement}}), so it will be closed, not deleted: sign-in is cut off and its data is kept for the legal retention periods. Do you want to proceed?
deletion.confirm_body_delete: "{{company}}" has no activity, so its account and all its data will be deleted permanently, with no way back. Do you want to proceed?

outcome.erased: Non-mandatory data erased — mandatory data kept

support.title: Technical support mode
support.subtitle: Access to a company's data only with its approval · read only · fully logged for the company
support.reason_placeholder: Example: checking an invoice numbering complaint
support.scope_label: Screen scope (the owner sees it before approving; anything outside it stays closed)
support.err_fields: Choose the company and write a clear reason (5 characters or more); the owner sees it word for word.
support.err_scope: Select the screens the check needs; access without a scope is not an instruction, and the owner sees it before deciding.

sub_processors.title: Sub-processors and merchant consent
sub_processors.err_retire: Could not remove it from the list
sub_processors.publish_title: Publish a new version — merchant consent is requested on it
sub_processors.publish_hint_lead: Publishing captures the current list ({{n}} processors) as fixed text and notifies every merchant who has not accepted it.
sub_processors.publish_hint_notice: The notice period is at least {{n}} days
sub_processors.ph_summary: What changed — in the merchant's words
sub_processors.no_versions: No version published yet, so no consent is required from anyone.
sub_processors.confirm_title: Publish a version of the sub-processor list
sub_processors.confirm_body: The version will be published with {{n}} processors and take effect on {{date}}. Every merchant is notified now and reminded before it takes effect; anyone who has not accepted by then is blocked until they accept, or download their data and close their account. Do you want to publish?

public_forms.title: Ready-made public templates
public_forms.hint: The platform owns the templates; a merchant copies one and edits their copy. A published template is not edited; a new version is created instead.
public_forms.publish_body: “{{name}}” version {{version}} will be published and appear in companies' catalogs, and the previous version is archived. Existing company copies do not change.
public_forms.delete_body: The draft of “{{name}}” version {{version}} will be deleted.
public_forms.err_load: Could not load the public templates
public_forms.err_new_version: Could not create a new version
